start.title: Set up RebaseRaven.
start.step1.title: Install RebaseRaven
start.step1.body: Download the macOS Apple Silicon or Windows x64 release.
start.step2.title: Install your tools
start.step2.body: Install Git or the Perforce CLI (p4). Select it in Settings if needed. Git LFS repositories also require Git LFS.
start.step3.title: Open a repository
start.step3.body: Open, clone, or initialize a Git repository. Connect a Perforce workspace or create one from a stream or depot path.
faq.title: About RebaseRaven.
faq.systems.question: Which platforms are available?
faq.systems.answer: Download macOS Apple Silicon or Windows x64 builds. Linux users can build from source with the Tauri platform prerequisites.
faq.tools.question: Which command-line tools are required?
faq.tools.answer: Install Git for Git repositories, or the Perforce CLI (p4) for Perforce workspaces. Select the executable in Settings if needed. Git LFS repositories also require Git LFS.
faq.accounts.question: Where are my repositories stored?
faq.accounts.answer: Local repositories and workspace files stay on your device. Remote operations use Git or Perforce to connect to the servers you configure.
faq.demo.question: Does the demo change a real repository?
faq.demo.answer: No. It uses invented data in your browser. Staging, committing, shelving, and submitting never affect a real repository.

faq.what.question: What is RebaseRaven?
faq.what.answer: RebaseRaven is a free, open-source desktop GUI for Git repositories and Perforce workspaces, built with Rust and Tauri. It supports diff review, history, commits, changelists, shelves, and conflict resolution on Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon.
faq.gitServers.question: Does RebaseRaven work with GitHub, GitLab, and self-hosted Git?
faq.gitServers.answer: RebaseRaven uses your installed Git to access local repositories and Git remotes over HTTPS or SSH. GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and other Git servers use your existing credentials and configuration. Hosting tasks such as pull request reviews stay on your Git service.
faq.bridge.question: Does RebaseRaven convert or sync Git and Perforce repositories?
faq.bridge.answer: Git repositories and Perforce workspaces are separate workflows in RebaseRaven. It does not convert repository history or synchronize changes between Git and Perforce.
faq.rust.question: How does RebaseRaven use Rust?
faq.rust.answer: Rust powers the desktop backend, with Tauri providing the application shell. The interface uses React and TypeScript. Git and Perforce repository operations run through your installed Git and p4 executables.
faq.license.question: Is RebaseRaven free to use?
faq.license.answer: Yes. RebaseRaven is free and open source under the MIT License. The source code and release installers are available on GitHub.
